runs.summary: Firecrawl discovery degraded again and returned zero usable candidates, so this run fell back to a broad live-search workflow. The strict shortlist stayed intentionally small: The East #1205 is the best under-cap 1BR, The East #1201 is the cleanest live 2BR/2BA under budget, and Iris Tribeca #11A is the only true 3BR/3BA strong enough to justify the $15,000 stretch. Beatrice slipped just over the 1BR hard cap, while several West Village and East Village leads stayed monitor-only because floor-plan, HVAC, or exact-layout proof remained incomplete.
runs.notes: This run began with `npm run discover:apartments -- --date 2026-05-20 --out data/firecrawl-discovery/2026-05-20.json`. The discovery file returned `status: degraded`, `degraded: true`, zero retained candidates, zero direct-operator candidates, and 27 fetch failures, so discovery was replaced with a broad live-search workflow rather than seeding from stored candidates. Firecrawl query set used the standard 18-query pack spanning 1BR, 2BR/2BA, and true 3BR/3BA discovery plus StreetEasy/Zillow/Apartments.com/RentHop site queries. Mapped roots were Equity Apartments, Avalon Communities, Brodsky, Stonehenge NYC, Rockrose, EVE NYC, StuyTown / Beam Living, The Chelsea / Greystar, and Chelsea29. Verification then proceeded from opened live pages only, prioritizing direct operator pages and exact StreetEasy unit pages.
blindSpots: Firecrawl degraded completely again today: zero retained candidates, zero direct-operator candidates, and 27 fetch failures across all search and map attempts.

Firecrawl query set used the standard 18 discovery queries; mapped roots were Equity Apartments, Avalon Communities, Brodsky, Stonehenge NYC, Rockrose, EVE NYC, StuyTown / Beam Living, The Chelsea / Greystar, and Chelsea29.
Some direct-operator pages still verified inventory only at the building availability-page level rather than through a dedicated unit detail page.
StreetEasy often exposed exact live unit pages, but some pages still omitted square footage or room dimensions even when a floor plan image was present.
EVE East Village still surfaced only stale cache results for specific units while the direct operator flow remained too generic to re-verify the same exact apartment live.
No fresh West Village or Chelsea 2BR/2BA direct-operator page cleared the proof bar today; the strongest 2BRs were East Village or Kips Bay adjacent.

listings.name: The East #1205
listings.verificationNote: Opened the exact StreetEasy unit page on 2026-05-20; the page showed #1205 at $5,295, 1 bed / 1 bath, available now, with a floor plan image plus explicit central air, dishwasher, washer/dryer, and oversized-window natural-light copy.

commute.notes: Longer and less direct than the west-side leaders, but still workable and usually around 30 minutes.

listings.mustHaveEvidence: The opened page explicitly listed central air, dishwasher, washer/dryer, and described oversized windows flooding the living and sleeping areas with natural light. A floor plan image was present on the same page.
listings.furnitureFit: Likely yes. The 3-room one-bedroom layout and visible floor plan suggest a real living area that should plausibly take the 100 inch couch plus coffee table, but confirm exact wall length during the tour.
caveats: East Village commute is longer and less direct than the best Chelsea or West Village options.
